answer.generated: A real-time system faces significant challenges in managing input data due to the inherent unpredictability and variability of external inputs. For instance, an avionics system in an aircraft exemplifies this challenge, as it must process inputs describing the current state of the aircraft’s flight, which cannot be controlled by the system itself. This lack of control over inputs underscores the necessity for robust and responsive real-time system designs capable of handling dynamic and unanticipated data streams effectively.
